episodes.title: UFO Cult That Changed Psychology
episodes.description:
Why do people sometimes believe *more* strongly after being proven wrong?

In 1954, a UFO cult known as The Seekers gathered to await rescue by extraterrestrials before the end of the world. The prophecy failed—but instead of abandoning their beliefs, many became even more convinced. Their extraordinary story inspired psychologist Leon Festinger to develop one of the most influential ideas in modern psychology: cognitive dissonance.

In this video, we explore the dramatic events behind When Prophecy Fails and A Theory of Cognitive Dissonance, uncovering why humans cling to cherished beliefs, reinterpret contradictory evidence, and protect their identities—even when reality says otherwise.
